storage.target: Cloudflare R2 with first-party custom asset domain

filename_rules: include version only when multiple approved variants must coexist
do not preserve random generator filenames as public canonical names
optimization_rules: Serve modern image formats where supported and materially smaller.
Generate responsive dimensions appropriate to actual rendered breakpoints.
Declare intrinsic width and height to reduce layout shift.
Prioritize only the true LCP asset; lazy-load below-the-fold media.
Avoid autoplaying heavyweight video on constrained mobile connections unless justified by UX and performance budgets.
Maintain meaningful alt text for informative imagery and empty alt text for purely decorative imagery.
Keep originals or high-quality masters outside the hot delivery path when practical.
release_rules: Generated media is not production-approved merely because generation succeeded.
Media must not encode or imply unapproved prices, availability, provider authorization, customer counts, rankings, testimonials or legal/compliance claims.
All implementation changes go through the release gates in autonomy-policy.json.
Commercial quarantine remains authoritative until commercial.json permits publication.
